annual_stages.caption: Table 4. Evaluation period MAE across the retained NYX stages
annual_stages.note: MAE in EUR/MWh. All three stages use the same 8,399 hours per country as Table 5. Reduction is relative to the Chronos-2 stage. Pooled n = 33,596.

annual_benchmark.caption: Table 5. Evaluation period NYX and Storm reporting-composite performance
annual_benchmark.note: All errors in EUR/MWh on 33,596 paired observations. Bias = forecast − observation. Storm includes recomputed fallback hours; Table 9 checks sensitivity to their exclusion.

extremes.caption: Table 6. NYX errors within realized extreme-price regimes
extremes.note: Errors in EUR/MWh. Negative: y < 0. High: y exceeds its country-specific initial-sample q99, held fixed thereafter. P10–P90 coverage is conditional on the realized regime and is not a stand-alone test of conditional calibration.

intervals.caption: Table 7. Evaluation period NYX interval evaluation
intervals.note: Coverage target: 80%; n = 8,400 per country. Width and scores are in EUR/MWh. WIS80 includes one interval plus the median and is not a complete-distribution score.

residual_test.caption: Table 8. Validation-selected residual configurations on the reserved 75 days
residual_test.note: n = 7,200 country–hours in the reserved segment. Errors in EUR/MWh; positive ΔMAE means worse than NYX. Validation uses frozen labels; test uses refreshed labels. Paired moving-block intervals use 2,000 replicates and seven-day blocks. Storm is not part of residual-model selection.

provenance_sensitivity.caption: Table 9. Pooled MAE sensitivity to source provenance
provenance_sensitivity.note: Errors in EUR/MWh. Samples are matched within each row and weighted by country–hour. No EPEX observed-label fallback lies within the retained dates. Excluding fallback values does not independently certify the remaining source vintages.

filters.caption: Table 10. Candidate additive corrections relative to the upstream median
rows: Linear combination of intercept, hour sine/cosine and 11 standardized market inputs
filters.note: The 11 market inputs are upstream median, interval width, CatBoost shift, five residual-load forecasts, their mean and range, and the French nuclear forecast. Symbols in this table describe candidate states; the final bounded weighted shift is b in Section 2.3.
